integrity: The 2026 primary source was inspected at the obstacle-envelope definition, maximality and boundary theorems, comparison principle, hull results, and its unit-ball examples. The new formula is independently verified by an explicit Levi calculation, maximality from rank deficiency, exact boundary matching, interior obstacle domination, and maximal comparison. The q>1 boundary is checked by the sign of the radial Levi eigenvalue.
scientific_limitations: The exact envelope is computed only for the one-coordinate power family with 0<q<=1. For q>1 the displayed orthogonal-shadow candidate is proved non-plurisubharmonic, but the actual envelope is not determined. No multi-coordinate anisotropic extension is asserted.
title: Exact coordinate-power Perron–Bremermann envelopes on the ball
